items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Wednesday, 29 July 2026 at 4:15am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Nil.


##Synopsis##

Low pressure centred to the north of Scotland.


##Wind##

Southwest 3 or 4, veering north or northwest 2 to 4 late afternoon, before settling west tonight.


##State of Sea##

Slight.


##Weather##

Isolated mist and fog patches at first, then light and patchy rain at times, mainly during the late afternoon and evening as it moves eastwards. Becoming fair overnight.


##Visibility##

Mostly good, occasionally moderate in rain, and very poor in any fog patches.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

West 3 or 4, occasionally 5, veering northwest 2 or 3 for a time overnight into Friday.


##State of Sea##

Slight.


##Weather##

Mainly fair.


##Visibility##

Mostly good.
